people.name: Lot
people.line: Abraham's nephew; rescued from Sodom's destruction

translations.web: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked
translations.bsb: and if He rescued Lot, a righteous man distressed by the depraved conduct of the lawless
translations.kjv: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:
translations.asv: and delivered righteous Lot, sore distressed by the lascivious life of the wicked
